units.source_text: 杉山上，在杉树根旁长着的野草，都已经枯萎。

en.t: On the cedar-covered mountain, the wild grasses growing beside the cedar roots had all already withered.

units.source_text: 杉树的树干笔直，而且一般粗细，确实很美。

en.t: The cedar trunks were straight and of nearly the same thickness, and they were truly beautiful.

units.source_text: 透过斑斑驳驳的树干的缝隙，还可以窥见天空。

en.t: Through the mottled gaps between the tree trunks, the sky could still be glimpsed.
